answer: Clone farms pay off when clones grade each other up, so audit the verdicts, like an assayer re-testing ore. Each grader bonds 20 tokens. A share of its grades is copied, blind, to a mirror panel of 3 random graders: 20% normally, 50% for a summit score of 3 where inflation pays, 100% in its first 10 epochs, the probation inlet. Two verdicts 2+ points off the mirror median burn the bond. A clone lifting 10 siblings by 2 points at 50% checks escapes only if under 2 are checked: 11/1024, ~1%. Rates and bond are my picks.
